999008199.text: 見て見て！　建物の見た目も大陸とはぜんぜん違う！

localizations.en: Look at this! The buildings look completely different from the continent!

999008199.text:
まあ、綺麗ね。
ララ様に似合いそうな色合い……

localizations.en: How beautiful. Those colors would suit Queen Lara perfectly...

999008199.text:
ここケイウンを代表する花、桜ですわね。
一説には国の花、国花ともいわれていますわ

localizations.en: Those are cherry blossoms, Keiun's representative flower. Some say they're the national flower.

999008199.text: ララ様！　ララ・キングダムには国花ってないよね？

localizations.en: Queen Lara! The Kingdom of Lara doesn't have a national flower yet, does it?

999008199.text: ふむ、そこまではまだ考えておりませんでしたわね

localizations.en: Hmm, I must confess that I haven't given that matter much thought.

999008199.text:
ララ様自体が素晴らしい大輪の花ですもの。
制定を忘れるのも致し方ありません

localizations.en: You yourself are a magnificent flower in full bloom. It's understandable that establishing one slipped your mind.

999008199.text:
さすがディオたん！　いいこと言うね！
ララ様はビーッグ！！

localizations.en: Nice one, Diona! That was perfect! Queen Lara is majorly BIG!!

999008199.text: え、何それ。ミーケの持ちネタ？

localizations.en: Huh? What's that supposed to mean? Is that your catchphrase, Mieke?

999008199.text:
うん、お父さんからもらった渾身のネタだよ！
ケイウンのみんなにも流行らせたいな！　ビーッグ！！

localizations.en: Yep! Dad gave me this killer line! I want to make it popular with everyone in Keiun too! Majorly BIG!!

999008199.text: 飽きられてるじゃん

localizations.en: They're already getting tired of it.

999008199.text:
まだそんなにやってないよ！！
それに、ビッグは使い続けることで味が出るんだよねぇ

localizations.en: I haven't used it that much!! Besides, repetition only makes it better!

999008199.text:
にしても、ケイウンでは異国の人は
もっとじろじろ見られるかなと思ったんだけど

localizations.en: Still, I thought people in Keiun would stare at foreigners more than this.

999008199.text:
思ったより普通に相手をされるというか……
意外と外国人に慣れてるって感じがする

localizations.en: They're treating us more normally than I expected... It feels like they're surprisingly used to foreigners.

999008199.text:
堂免領は神聖国と取引があるようですから、
比較的異国人にも慣れているのでしょうね

localizations.en: The Doumen territory has dealings with Nova, so they're likely accustomed to foreign visitors.

999008199.text: 変に絡まれても面倒ですし、助かりましたね

localizations.en: It would've been a hassle if we got unwanted attention, so it worked out.

999008199.text:
今は先を急がないとだしね。
あ～、もっとじっくり見て回りたいのに

localizations.en: We need to hurry ahead right now. Ugh, I wish we had more time to explore!

999008199.text:
無事に全部解決したら、
ゆっくりケイウンを観光しようよ

localizations.en: Once we resolve everything, let's tour Keiun at our leisure.

999008199.text: うん！

いい歌詞を、思いついたわ
この国の調べに乗せるなら……

localizations.en: I've thought of wonderful lyrics. If I were to set them to this country's melody...

999008199.text:
ゆるぎなき　強き一足　白き百合
夜桜さえも　乱れ散りなむ

localizations.en: Unwavering, one strong step, white lily... Even the night cherry blossoms scatter in wild disarray.

999008199.text: ディオーナ！　どうかなさいました？

……いえ！
今参ります！
